description: Pin a memory to the focus buffer for guaranteed context inclusion. Focused memories always appear in prompt context (max 3). Error if buffer is full — caller must unfocus something first.
embedding_description: Pin a memory to the focus buffer for guaranteed context inclusion. Returns confirmation; errors on not-found, archived memory, already_focused, or buffer-full (safety valve MAX_FOCUSED=20; actual prompt-context budget is FOCUS_BUDGET_FRACTION at assembly time). Use to hold a key fact in working memory. Distinct from get_focused (read), unfocus (release).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that the memory has been pinned to the focus buffer
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Pinning a memory to the focus buffer for guaranteed context inclusion
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: MemoryNotFoundError: the specified memory_id does not exist. FocusBufferFullError: focus buffer already has 3 memories — unfocus one first. AlreadyFocusedError: the memory is already in the focus buffer.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For memory not found: verify the memory_id is correct. For buffer full: use unfocus to remove a memory before adding a new one. For already focused: the memory is already pinned.
